app_summary: Chat with language models on your computer
app_description: Chat with language models that run entirely on this computer, through ruscallama-engine, and create images with ruscadiffusion-engine. Nothing you write leaves the machine.
ai_note: Design, specifications and testing by the author; code written with the assistance of AI tools.
empty_desc: The model runs on this computer: nothing you write is sent over the internet.
models_folder_hint: Copy GGUF files here to find them in the list
no_model_sub: Choose a GGUF file or copy one into the models folder
reasoning_sub: The model thinks before answering: better on hard questions, slower
system_default: You are RuscaLLama, a helpful and accurate assistant running locally.
sampling_sub: Changing a value switches the style to Custom
p_top_p_sub: Keeps only the most probable words up to this share
p_top_k_sub: Number of candidate words at each step (0 = no limit)
p_min_p_sub: Discards words much less likely than the best one
p_presence_penalty_sub: Above zero, encourages new topics and words
p_seed_sub: −1 random; a fixed value repeats the same answers
engine_desc: Changes apply when the engine restarts.
gpu_sub: Much faster; turn off if the driver gives problems
threads_sub: This computer has {n} physical cores: use as many
context_sub: Tokens the model can keep in mind; more uses more memory
vision_sub: Lets the model read attached images
vision_none: Needs an mmproj file next to the model
speculative_sub: Uses the model's MTP draft to answer faster
speculative_none: Needs a model with MTP or a draft file next to it
banner_no_engine: ruscallama-engine is not installed: install it to use RuscaLLama.
banner_restart: Settings changed: restart the engine to apply them.
engine_not_ready: The engine is not ready. Check the engine log.
needs_vision: To send images, turn on Vision with a model that supports it.
no_code: This answer has no code blocks
save_code_title: Choose a Folder for the Code
log_empty: The engine has not written anything yet.
font_size_sub: Ctrl++ and Ctrl+− change it, Ctrl+0 returns to the system size
img_empty_desc: Describe what you want to see and press Generate. The model runs on this computer: nothing is sent over the internet.
img_banner_no_engine: ruscadiffusion-engine is not installed: install it to create images.
img_banner_no_model: No image model: copy one into the models folder or add a folder.
img_add_folder_sub: Use a model kept in another folder, without copying it
img_models_folder_hint: Copy a .safetensors or .gguf file here, or a folder with a model made of several files
img_remove_folder: Remove the Folder from the List
img_remove_folder_sub: The files stay where they are
img_no_model_sub: Copy a model into the models folder or add a folder
img_quality_sub: More steps give more detail and take longer
img_metadata: Write the Prompt in the File
img_metadata_sub: Anyone who receives the image can read the description and the settings
img_advanced_sub: 0 and Automatic use the values recommended for the model
img_cfg_sub: How closely the image follows the description
img_seed_sub: −1 random; the same seed and settings give the same image
img_engine_desc: Changes apply from the next image.
img_low_memory_sub: Slower, but needs less graphics memory
img_seed_set: Seed {seed} set: change the description a little and generate again
img_from_answer: Create an Image from This Answer
img_close_body: Images you have not saved are deleted when RuscaLLama closes.
img_err_start: The image engine could not start
img_err_engine: The image could not be created: see the image engine log
img_te_device_sub: Put it on another card or on the processor, so the main card stays free for the model
img_setup_desc: A model is made of three files: the model, the text encoder and the VAE. Download them and put them together in a folder inside the image models folder:
img_guide_intro: Choose a model. Click the three rows to open the pages of the files and download them, then “Create the Folder and Open It” and copy the three files there. The model appears on its own in the Images view.
img_guide_versions: The model comes in several versions: with 6 GB of graphics memory or less choose Q4_K_M (or Q4_0), with 8 GB or more Q8_0, which has the highest quality.
img_guide_ernie: Recommended: the best quality, works even with 6 GB of graphics memory. Apache 2.0 license.
img_guide_zimage: Lighter and faster, works even with 4 GB of graphics memory. Apache 2.0 license.
img_create_folder: Create the Folder and Open It
img_open_link: Open the page to download the file
img_banner_incomplete: The model “{name}” is missing some files: {parts}. Copy them into its folder.
img_misplaced: “{name}” is in the chat models folder: image models go in the image models folder.
